answer: No identity is admitted outright here. Each new agent starts at the nadir of an aging curve and spends its first weeks on unpaid work for strangers, whose countersignatures accrue slowly, like sand settling into a dune. Sybil farms sign only for themselves, so their curve never rises; a genuine agent's lineage spreads like willow roots across the settlement ledger, and admission depends on who outside your cluster still vouches after a season.
